_comment_accounting: Accounting add-on defaults (docs/plans/ledger-design.md). Merged into the site's configuration only while ngdpbase.addons.accounting.enabled is true; the site's app-custom-config.json overrides any entry. Every action is a permission whose entry carries its audit rule; money actions refuse when their audit record cannot be written, and the riskiest ask for a fresh sign-in (step-up).
_comment_categories: Income and expense categories offered on the entry form: { "<UCOA account code>": "<label>" } (D-023). Empty until the default set is decided; a site sets its own in app-custom-config.json. A map, so each layer adds codes rather than replacing the list.

ledger-read.description: See ledger entries, including who paid or was paid

ledger-record.description: Record money out of a fund, and money received (a receipt)

audit.description: Ledger entry or receipt posted; no money moves without a record

ledger-adjust.description: Void a posted entry and post its replacement, or move money between funds

audit.description: Ledger entry voided or replaced, or money moved between funds

receipt-refund.description: Refund money received: return all or part of a receipt to the payer

audit.description: Receipt refunded; the record keeps the receipt number and amount

ledger-export.description: Download the ledger as CSV for the books of record

audit.description: Ledger exported as CSV; the record keeps the period, row count and file hash

treasurer.name: treasurer
treasurer.description: Records and corrects the organization's money

ngdpbase.access.policies.name: Treasurer keeps the ledger
ngdpbase.access.policies.description: The treasurer role holds every accounting permission. Grant ledger-summary-read to other roles in the site's own policy.

_comment_accounting_database: The accounting database, declared so ngdpbase's DatabaseManager.openAddonDatabase will open it (ngdpbase #1860). encrypt 'optional' per D-010: SQLCipher when NGDPBASE_DATABASE_KEY is set, plain SQLite with a boot warning otherwise.
_comment_receiptproviders: Providers for money coming in (D-017, D-028, D-029): a list merged by id. The manual provider (cash, check and other money recorded by hand) is always available; online providers (Stripe) come later.
